cohort: 125 pregnant women presented with non-reactive cardiotocography at Shahida Islam Teaching Hospital, Lodhran.
finding: Non-reactive cardiotocography was highly associated with poor fetal outcomes, including low birth weight (52.8%), low Apgar scores (35.2%), stillbirth (3.2%), NICU admission (36.8%), and neonatal mortality (7.2%).
mod_finding: Cesarean section was the mode of delivery for 64% of the participants.
birth_weight: Low birth weight was found in 52.8% of the neonates.
